## How it was verified

Not "tests pass" — say what you ran and what it showed. Measurements and before/after numbers
are worth more than a description.

- [ ] `pytest` in `proj2/`
- [ ] Cypress, if this touches a template or a route
- [ ] Black and Ruff on the files this branch changed (`bash scripts/check-changed.sh main`)
- [ ] Checked against the running app, if this changes something a person sees
